title: crash/render issues with 'termbidi', 'rightleft' after inputting hebrew

labels.name: needs:repro
labels.description: We need minimal steps to reproduce the issue

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
neovim crashes when termbidi is set after setting rightleft and then inputting hebrew

OS: Endeavour OS
## neovim version:
```

See ":help feature-compile"

   system vimrc file: "$VIM/sysinit.vim"
  fall-back for $VIM: "/usr/share/nvim"

Run :checkhealth for more info
```
I can't seem to find $NVIM_LOG_FILE

## Steps to reproduce:
1. `nvim -u NORC +"set rightleft"`
2. enter insert mode with `i`
3. type some hebrew characters
4. exit insert mode
5. `:set termbidi`
and then it crashes with a SIGSEGV
